canonical_measurement.definition: exact minimum Euclidean distance between a receptor heavy atom and a ligand heavy atom
canonical_measurement.applies_to: every ligand form, small molecule and polymer alike
canonical_measurement.storage: min_distance_angstrom, full float precision; display rounding is a separate field
canonical_measurement.rule: thresholds are DERIVED from the exact distance; the data are never rounded at generation time

thresholds.meaning: main display / contact-shell threshold, consistent with the frozen aminergic work

monotonicity: within_4A implies within_4_5A implies within_5A; asserted by test
polymer_interface_naming: for polymer site classes the 5 Å result is an 'interface shell'. It does not by itself constitute a shared pocket and is never pooled with small-molecule pockets.
covalent: a covalent bond is stored as a separate relationship and never substitutes for a distance cutoff
prohibition: no threshold is used to assign ligand identity or pharmacology
pathology_rule: if a pilot shows unexpected pathology: keep the exact distance data, halt production eligibility for the affected site class, do NOT silently change the threshold, and raise a blocker in the Phase 3 status report
